project.title: Private workspace-control migration rehearsal
project.goal: Port all30 control migrations with whole-suffix atomicity and opaque credential preservation.
project.scope: R12 private-copy control prefixes0–30 only; full writer admission/authority/platform mandate preserved.

component.storage.description: Own bounded private SQLite migration rehearsal.

boundary.responsibility: Capture, recover, validate, migrate and discard private copies.
boundary.rationale: Original writer admission is not yet complete.
excludes: Live migrations, domain writes and promotion

action.rehearse_control_migration.description: Rehearse exact workspace-control migrations privately with full-prefix schema validation.

preconditions: Explicit local read authority; strict supported prefix; no migration authority inferred.
postconditions: Original source and company files unchanged; private copy closed/deleted.
Whole pending suffix commits atomically, prior provenance preserved, v5 explicitly invalidates all sessions and backfills enabled-user evidence.
Credential rows/digests/identifiers and database-supplied exception text never appear in public output.
external_effects: Read/stat source files; recover/migrate/delete private disposable files only.

authorization.rationale: Read authority only; credentials remain opaque and no live writer authority.

concurrency.rationale: Capture stable source while legacy reader/writer may be active.

atomicity.rationale: Real transactional rollback and process death.

action.rehearse_control_migration.behavior: Verify all raw artifacts, capture existing private control source, validate strict prefix/full schema, compare opaque data with explicit v5 session/MFA transformation, run entire pending suffix in one immediate transaction, validate before commit, close/delete copy and return sanitized public evidence.

scenario.normal.description: Whole canonical schema/history parity and unchanged source inventories.

scenario.when: Rehearse all pending control migrations and compare independent TypeScript result.
scenario.then: Whole canonical schema/history parity and unchanged source inventories.

scenario.history.description: Reject without repair or checksum adoption.

scenario.given: Gapped/newer/altered/missing strict history or artifact drift.
scenario.then: Reject without repair or checksum adoption.

scenario.checkpoint.description: Typed sanitized refusal with no secret data or source effects.

scenario.then: Typed sanitized refusal with no secret data or source effects.

scenario.isolation.description: No company/source effects and no canary/identifier/data digest leakage.

scenario.given: Missing/linked/changing control source or credential canaries in valid opaque rows.
scenario.then: No company/source effects and no canary/identifier/data digest leakage.

scenario.failure.description: All pending DDL/history/data changes roll back, including earlier session invalidation.

scenario.given: Valid prefix28 with conflicting active assignments or test-private history insertion failure.
scenario.then: All pending DDL/history/data changes roll back, including earlier session invalidation.

scenario.crash.description: Entire old/new prefix including sessions; no half history, all children reaped.

scenario.given: Disposable child with pre-v5 users and sessions.
scenario.when: Kill during v5, later after v5, before final commit or after commit.
scenario.then: Entire old/new prefix including sessions; no half history, all children reaped.

scenario.guards.description: Audit/history updates/deletes refuse; enrollment revokes only enrolled-user sessions.

scenario.given: Migrated synthetic audit/history and MFA/non-MFA sessions.
scenario.when: Attempt immutable changes and MFA enrollment.
scenario.then: Audit/history updates/deletes refuse; enrollment revokes only enrolled-user sessions.

scenario.repeat.description: No migration/data repair; aggregate session effects zero.

scenario.then: No migration/data repair; aggregate session effects zero.

scenario.concurrent.description: Private recovery or bounded refusal; original files unchanged.

scenario.given: Synthetic independent connection retaining live control WAL.
scenario.then: Private recovery or bounded refusal; original files unchanged.
